name: shebang-mcp-sdk
description: Shebang MCP SDK - the Model Context Protocol (MCP) SDK for shell environments (POSIX sh/Bash & PowerShell), analogous to python-sdk for Python and @modelcontextprotocol/sdk for TypeScript. Contains NO application-specific logic — consumers override tool handlers via global functions. Integrates with the MCP Builder Skill for building production MCP servers.
